points.description: Explains that the water froze (turned to ice) when the temperature fell below 0 °C, and that the water/ice expanded, so it needed more space than the bottle could provide. Equivalent wording earns the mark, e.g. 'the water turned to ice and expanded, pushing against the bottle'.

rubric.notes: Full marks for a student who links freezing to expansion of the water, which causes the bottle to crack. Freezing without expansion, or expansion without freezing, does not earn the mark, since the model answer's explanation depends on both. This is a single all-or-nothing point worth 1 mark.
